chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
The founding party arrived in summer. It included Hallmund Eiriksson, Kauppi, Minvydė, Vaigirdė, Áila, Kauko, Aodhán, Vaivydė, Thorfrid Ketilsdóttir and Eadric.

Hallmund Eiriksson, Vaivydė and Eadric worked as fishers. Kauppi, Minvydė, Vaigirdė, Kauko, Aodhán and Thorfrid Ketilsdóttir worked as farmers. Áila worked as a hunter.

Vaigirdė and Aodhán were already partners. Kauko and Thorfrid Ketilsdóttir were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.

The founding party had two adult does and one adult buck and 1 longship.
